---
title: Vendors
description: The vendor record is the starting point of the purchase cycle.
---

Vendors are the starting point of the purchase cycle. Purchase documents pull
their information from the vendor record.

Vendors are managed from **Vendors Management** in the sidebar, which contains
**Vendors**, **Notes**, and **Activites**.

## The Vendors list

Go to **Vendors Management → Vendors**. The list shows each vendor's **Name**,
**Website Url**, and **Category**.

<Screenshot src="/images/purchases/vendors/vendor-list-annotated.jpg" alt="Vendors list with toolbar and row actions highlighted" caption="(1) Export, (2) Import, (3) New Vendor, (4) Category filter, (5) Search, (6) expand a row, (7) View, Edit, Clone, and Delete." />

| Control | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Category** | Filter vendors by category. |
| **Search** | Search the list. |
| Expand arrow | Shows the vendor's financial summary in the list. |
| **View** (eye) | Opens the vendor detail page. |
| **Edit** (pencil) | Edits the vendor. |
| **Clone** (copy) | Duplicates the vendor record. |
| **Delete** (bin) | Deletes the vendor. |
| **Export** | Exports the vendor list. |
| **Import** | Bulk imports vendors from an Excel template. |

Expanding a row shows **Current Month Expense**, **Lifetime Expense**,
**Outstanding Amount**, **Vendor Credit**, and **Returns**, plus **Expense
Distribution** and **Bills Status** charts.

<Screenshot src="/images/purchases/vendors/vendor-row-summary.jpg" alt="Expanded vendor row with financial summary" caption="Select the arrow (1) to expand a vendor and see its financial summary (2)." />
